estimand: cohort median of the preregistered image-level aggregate
image_level_aggregation_order: compute primitive metrics from signed scientific arrays without display transforms
reduce patches/cells/heads inside each image-block-condition exactly as specified by metric registry
arithmetic-mean the four fixed blocks within each depth group for that image
form within-image paired deep-minus-shallow or intervention-minus-control contrasts
perform cohort inference only on one contrast row per image
trajectory_rule: for every registered metric report all blocks 0..11 in order as cohort median and 95% image-bootstrap CI; trajectories, all middle-depth contrasts and any local extrema are estimation/descriptive and cannot select a confirmatory block

bootstrap.resampling_unit: image with all repeated measures retained together
bootstrap.ci: two-sided percentile 95% using numpy quantile method=linear
bootstrap.median_even_n: arithmetic mean of the two middle sorted observations

tests.directional_margin_test: p=(1+count(null sign-flip median >= observed median of d-margin))/(B+1)

hypotheses.image_aggregate: arithmetic mean over blocks 0..11 of NNS deletion-loss AUC minus the median of 32 patch-uniform tie-control AUCs
hypotheses.support: Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and 95% CI lower bound>0.02

families.role: primary confirmatory depth organization and head-control family

hypotheses.image_aggregate: mean Fisher-z Spearman across 12 blocks between head absolute allocation and normalized clean-logit ablation loss
mean across 12 blocks; heads ranked only by preregistered absolute allocation with hash tie-break

families.default_two_sided_support: Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and the 95% CI lies wholly above +threshold or wholly below -threshold
families.directional_support: Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and 95% CI lower bound exceeds threshold

families.role: secondary confirmatory perturbation-modulation family; not a spatial-robustness family
families.condition_aggregation: within image compute each non-clean condition-minus-clean endpoint, then arithmetic-mean over all eight conditions and all 12 blocks; no condition may be selected
families.support: Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and 95% CI lower bound exceeds threshold

descriptive_only: signed conductance directions not listed as confirmatory endpoints
